scope: Existing compute reduce-helper factories plus the 19 dataflow-extension hosts in the migration inventory. Direct operation unit suites, their validation/cache/numerical/performance cases, model per-op suites, and C++ operation/UDM tests. End-to-end model suites and incidental math in unrelated tests are outside this suite.
counting: Each Python test function/method is selected once; pytest expands all parameters and fixtures. Each C++ TEST/TEST_F is one case. Disabled C++ tests are retained as pytest skips unless explicitly enabled. Tests can cover more than one factory; mapping is a family selection aid, not proof that every case executes every listed factory.
